mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_chat_session privacy_session JOIN ai_chat_turn privacy_turn ON privacy_turn.workspace_id = privacy_session.workspace_id AND privacy_turn.session_id = privacy_session.id AND privacy_turn.id = p.origin_turn_id JOIN ai_chat_message privacy_message ON privacy_message.workspace_id = privacy_session.workspace_id AND privacy_message.session_id = privacy_session.id AND privacy_message.id = p.message_id WHERE privacy_session.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND privacy_session.id = p.session_id AND privacy_session.organization_privacy_generation = p.organization_privacy_generation AND privacy_turn.organization_privacy_generation = p.organization_privacy_generation AND privacy_message.organization_privacy_generation = p.organization_privacy_generation AND privacy_turn.privacy_generation = p.privacy_generation)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_tool_call (workspace_id, message_id, tool_name, status, arguments_json, thought_signature, idempotency_key, server_proposal, proposal_key, proposal_ordinal, proposal_prepared_at, privacy_generation, organization_privacy_generation, created_at, updated_at) SELECT p.workspace_id, p.message_id, p.tool_name, 'proposed', #{argumentsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{thoughtSignature,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, #{idempotencyKey}, TRUE, p.proposal_key, #{proposalOrdinal}, #{proposalPreparedAt}, p.privacy_generation, p.organization_privacy_generation, p.created_at, p.created_at FROM ai_assistant_proposal_set p JOIN ai_chat_session privacy_session ON privacy_session.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND privacy_session.id = p.session_id WHERE p.organization_privacy_generation = #{organizationPrivacyGeneration} AND p.organization_privacy_generation = privacy_session.organization_privacy_generation AND AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.session_id = #{sessionId} AND p.proposal_key = #{proposalKey} AND p.message_id = #{messageId} AND p.requested_by_user_id = #{requestedByUserId} AND CAST(p.tool_name AS BINARY) = CAST(#{toolName} AS BINARY) AND p.publication_state = 'staged' AND #{proposalOrdinal} BETWEEN 1 AND p.row_count AND #{proposalPreparedAt} IS NOT NULL AND #{proposalPreparedAt} <= p.created_at AND #{idempotencyKey} IS NOT NULL AND #{serverProposal} = TRUE
mapper.select: SELECT tc.*, p.session_id, p.requested_by_user_id, p.invocation_mode, p.publication_state FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc JOIN ai_assistant_proposal_set p ON p.workspace_id = tc.workspace_id AND p.proposal_key = tc.proposal_key WHERE p.organization_privacy_generation = #{organizationPrivacyGeneration} AND tc.organization_privacy_generation = p.organization_privacy_generation AND tc.privacy_generation = p.privacy_generation AND AND tc.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.session_id = #{sessionId} AND tc.proposal_key = #{proposalKey} ORDER BY tc.proposal_ordinal

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_assistant_proposal_set p JOIN ai_chat_message m ON m.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND m.session_id = p.session_id AND m.id = p.message_id JOIN ai_chat_turn t ON t.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND t.session_id = p.session_id AND t.id = p.origin_turn_id WHERE p.organization_privacy_generation = #{organizationPrivacyGeneration} AND AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.session_id = #{sessionId} AND p.proposal_key = #{proposalKey} AND m.organization_privacy_generation = p.organization_privacy_generation AND t.organization_privacy_generation = p.organization_privacy_generation AND t.privacy_generation = p.privacy_generation AND m.author_kind = 'user' AND m.author_user_id <=> p.requested_by_user_id AND t.requested_by_user_id <=> p.requested_by_user_id AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc WHERE tc.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND tc.proposal_key = p.proposal_key) = p.row_count AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_chat_tool_call tc WHERE tc.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND tc.proposal_key = p.proposal_key AND (tc.proposal_ordinal NOT BETWEEN 1 AND p.row_count OR tc.organization_privacy_generation != p.organization_privacy_generation OR tc.privacy_generation != p.privacy_generation OR tc.message_id != p.message_id OR CAST(tc.tool_name AS BINARY) != CAST(p.tool_name AS BINARY) OR tc.server_proposal != TRUE OR tc.created_at != p.created_at OR tc.proposal_prepared_at IS NULL OR tc.proposal_prepared_at > p.created_at) ) )
